name: goap_packaged_loop_increment_to_ten
mechanism: Mirror of goap_packaged_loop_decrement_to_zero.meta.json, testing counting UP. Same verification chain: raw primitive 'increment' (precond counter(Id,X)+succ(X,X2); effects swap X for X2) independently proven, via real plan() calls, to reach a FIXED target (10) from many distinct starting points in exactly (10-start) steps -- then a new action 'increment_to_ten' (precond counter(Id,X); effect counter(Id,10); cost 1) is packaged and acid-tested on a never-seen starting value.
given_background: ONE generic primitive action 'increment' (precond counter(Id,X)+succ(X,X2); effects del counter(Id,X), add counter(Id,X2)) plus a succ(X,X2) chain relation (X2=X+1) -- given background.
engine_limitation_discovered: This GOAP engine (hosts.rs's ground_action_instances) only binds action variables by unifying PRECONDS against the current world state -- a variable appearing ONLY in an effect (never in any precond) cannot be resolved from the goal being searched for. So a fully general 'increment_to(Id,Target)' action with a free Target in its effect cannot work: Target would remain an unsubstituted literal string, never matching a concrete goal fact. This means the honest mirror of decrement_to_zero is 'any start -> FIXED target' (target=10, same role as decrement's fixed 0), not 'any start -> any target' -- discovered while designing this test, not hand-waved around.
visible_verification: Raw 'increment' alone reaches counter(t,10) in exactly (10-start) steps for start in [0,2,5,7,8], each in an isolated fresh subprocess.
blind_verification: start=3, held back, reached target in exactly 7 steps using only the raw primitive, before any shortcut existed.
acid_test: After registering 'increment_to_ten' (cost 1), a brand-new never-tested start=1 produced plan([[counter,[t,10]]]) = single step 'increment_to_ten(Id=t,X=1)', not 9 unrolled increment steps -- the planner genuinely preferred the packaged action for an unseen input.
provenance: direct response to: 'See if it can generalize to counting up instead of down', following goap_packaged_loop_decrement_to_zero.meta.json.
scope_note: Same honest limit as the decrement case, plus the newly-discovered engine constraint above: packages ONE specific loop (any start reaching the fixed target 10), not an arbitrary-target increment action, which this engine cannot express via unbound effect variables.
